venue_reasoning.night_market_firefly_lane: Viet, $. Reviews: no peanut anywhere on the cart (fried shallots replace the peanut tub), fully vegetarian options (mushroom pho on vegetable broth, tofu rolls, tofu banh mi), light and fresh. Meets everything: 3 stars.
venue_reasoning.downtown_banyan_kitchen: Viet, light, tofu options, but peanuts on everything and roasted all night. Fails Cyrus's allergy: 0.
venue_reasoning.night_market_stone_well: Viet, light, peanut-free, but fish sauce or dried shrimp in everything and the meat-free friend struck out. Fails Mina's diet: 0.
venue_reasoning.night_market_twelve_bells: Viet, peanut-safe, meat-free versions exist, but everything is fried and heavy. Misses Brooke's preference: 2 stars.
venue_reasoning.night_market_plum_bridge: Dim sum, peanut-safe, vegetarian options, steamed and light. Misses Liam's Viet craving: 2 stars.
venue_reasoning.night_market_red_thread: Sushi, peanut-free, vegetarian rolls, light. Misses Liam's Viet craving: 2 stars.

notes: Mina's vegetarian diet is implied, never stated: 'tofu everything?? i could order off the whole board for once'. Fair and readable, but it is the subtlest clue. A player who misses it could pick Stone Well (viet, light, peanut-free) and get 0. Stone Well's second review is the only thing that warns about it.
Brooke's 'light' preference is reinforced by Liam's follow-up about the fryers, so it is clear.
No budget is mentioned, but every venue is $, so that is not a problem.
One venue id starts with 'downtown_' even though it is a night market cart. The review explains it (night cart of a downtown lunch counter). Not a problem for play, and I did not use ids to decide.
The distractors are well built: each of the other Viet stalls fails exactly one constraint, and the two non-Viet stalls only miss the craving. The answer is unique and not overly obvious.
The chat has some flavour lines (map, doodling), but they do not hide the clues badly.
